description: Sends a message to the room of a channel by HTTP. The speaker is the guest (`X-Guest-Token`), the same one that the WebSocket recognizes; without a guest, the account session.

author.description: Nickname to use; without it, the server makes a stable one.

channel_id.description: Channel ID in the catalog, for example `GloboNews.br`.

name: chat_send
title: Send a chat message
